description: This Java class `ArtifactInfoContext` manages sets of various artifact identifiers (entity names, service names, locations, etc.) used for gathering artifact information within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoContext
classes.description: A final class designed for collecting and retrieving various artifact identifiers relevant to OFBiz widget artifacts.

methods.name: addEntityName
methods.description: Adds a non-null entity name to the context set.

methods.name: addFormLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null form location to the context set.

methods.name: addRequestLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null request location to the context set.

methods.name: addScreenLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null screen location to the context set.

methods.name: addServiceName
methods.description: Adds a non-null service name to the context set.

methods.name: addTargetLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null target location to the context set.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns the set of entity names in the context.

methods.name: getFormLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of form locations.

methods.name: getRequestLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of request locations.

methods.name: getScreenLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of screen locations.

methods.name: getServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the set of service names.

methods.name: getTargetLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of target locations.
